data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic verb 'najaja', meaning to guide, protect, or support. In Islamic context, Najjia symbolizes a faithful guide, helper, or companion on the path to righteousness. The name Najjia carries the meaning “Guide, companion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Najjia usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of guidance and support.
data.etymology: Najjia belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Najjia total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: نججия
in_arabic.long_meaning: نججية هي اسم عربي مشتق من الجذر نَجَء، والذي يعني التوقعات، المتوقعة، المأمولة، الناجية، البنات الصادقة. في الإسلام، يُعتبر اسم نججية من أسماء السيدة فاطمة بنت محمد، ابنة النبي محمد. يُقال أن اسم نججية يُرمز إلى الشخصية الحسنة، والصادقة، والناجحة، وتُعتبر مظاهرةً للطاعة والخضوع. يُستخدم اسم نججية في مناسبات مختلفة خلال الأعياد والأعياد الإسلامية، مثل عيد الفطر وبداية شهر رمضان، حيث يُعتبر اسم نججية مناسبة للشابات الصالحات

in_urdu.name: نججیا

in_hindi.name: नज्जिया

in_pashto.name: نججیہ

in_english.name: Najjia
in_english.long_meaning: The name Najjia is of Arabic origin, derived from the root NJ, which means expected, mehmet, nagiya. In Islam, Najjia is a name associated with Fatima, daughter of the Prophet Muhammad. It is said that the name Najjia refers to the righteous, truthful girls who are mehmet, nagiya, and expected. Najjia is an important name in Islamic tradition and is often used in celebrations such as Eid al-Fitr and the beginning of Ramadan.
